question: Who among the following won a bronze medal in the Summer Olympics 2020 (played in 2021)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PV Sindhu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Summer Olympics is a major multi-sport event organized once in four years by International Olympic Organization (IOC).
 
• The most recent edition of the summer Olympics,** Tokyo 2020**, Japan was held in 2021 behind closed doors because of the pandemic and the Mascot for this event is called Miraitowa.
 
 
• The United States won the most medals (113 overall and 39 Gold medals), followed by China (88 medals) and Japan (58 medals).
 
 
 
• **PV Sindhu won the straight Olympic bronze medal in Tokyo 2020, it was her second straight Olympic medal and became the first Indian woman to win two medals in the Olympics. Hence option 3 is correct. **
 
 
• In 2017 and 2018, she won the silver medal in BWF World Championship.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya** is an Indian freestyle wrestler from Haryana who won the **Silver medal at the Olympics Tokyo 2020** in the 57 kg category.

 
 
• ​He also won a Bronze medal in World Wrestling Championship in 2019 and a Gold medal in Birmingham Commonwealth Games in 2022.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is an Indian track and field athlete from Haryana, who won the **Gold medal in Tokyo Olympics 2020**, in Men's Javelin throw.
 
 
• ​In 2022, he won the Silver medal in the World Athletics Championship and became the second Indian to win a medal at World Athletics Championship.
 
• **In 2022, he was honoured with Padma Sri.**
 
 
 
• **​****Mirabai Chanu** is an Indian weightlifter from Manipur who won the **Gold medal at Commonwealth Games 2022 and a Silver medal at Tokyo Olympics 2020. **
 
 
• ​**She was honoured with Padma Sri and Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in 2018.**
 
 

14a:T1
